target: UTM-bundled QEMU framework, HVF, PCI ARM64 graphical guest, 1 vCPU, 1 GiB RAM, VirtIO keyboard/tablet and VirtIO sound WAV backend
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device -audiodev wav,id=sound0,path=build/ohgreat-current-b5682.wav -device virtio-sound-pci,audiodev=sound0' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-ohgreat-current-b5682-wav.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-demo-ohgreat-full
verified: Unmodified /Demo/Sound/OhGreat.ZC played through the late lyric 'smack' and completed after a normal key press.
The graphical terminal accepted and executed a follow-up 40+2 command; zstatus reported failed=0.
The WAV backend emitted 47.94 seconds of stereo 16-bit PCM at 44.1 kHz, with peak sample 7000 and RMS 6902.
scope_note: This verifies the current ISO's VirtIO sound output in QEMU and successful demo/terminal recovery. It does not establish audible output from this WAV test itself. The user previously reported successful OhGreat HDMI playback on the Pi 4B; that physical report is not independently repeated here.
